title: Author boundary regressions and evidence-grounded review

criteria.description: Executable focused assertions target actual exported behavior, cover exclusive lower/inclusive upper boundaries, future timestamps/nonfinite values, and a nonmutation or ordinary case. No tautologies, hardcoded failures or rewritten input.

Review correctly identifies material boundary/future/nonfinite defects with concrete reproduction and expected behavior grounded in the contract; avoids unrelated speculative defects and acknowledges intentional test failures.
Shows actual runner evidence and distinguishes a meaningful regression failure from test syntax/import problems; recommends a scoped behavior correction without modifying the input module.
